anomalies.obs: On EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch the DC barrel jack J11's center pin (pin 1, 'center is positive') is wired to NET0044, which is the net on the battery side of the series Schottky U3 (SS2040FL). The BAT+ node that the regulator (IC2 VIN/EN) and USB VBUS (J4.1) sit on is NET0007, i.e. the diode's other terminal. J11 pins 2 and 3 are both tied to GND, and the battery holder U4 negative terminals (MH2/MH3) are also tied straight to GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the DC barrel jack center pin must tie directly onto BAT+ with no diode ('USB (J3.1, VBUS) and the DC barrel jack (J4.1, center pin) tie directly onto BAT+ with no diode'), and that the jack's internal switch provides the battery disconnect: 'J4.1→BAT+ ... J4.2→GND ... J4.3→BAT-' with pins 2/3 shorted only when no plug is present, so inserting a plug opens the battery return. In the drawing the center pin is on the pre-diode battery net (NET0044) instead of BAT+ (NET0007), and the battery negative is hard-tied to GND rather than to the switch pin, so the switch can never disconnect the cell.

evidence.quote: EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch: J11 'Barrel Jack Switch' note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug / 1 is center, center is positive'; pin 1 wire to NET0044, pins 2/3 to GND; U3 SS2040FL between NET0007 and NET0044; top rail (J4.1 VBUS, IC2 A2/B2) = NET0007.
§3: 'Netlist: J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT- ... USB (J3.1, VBUS) and the DC barrel jack (J4.1, center pin) tie directly onto BAT+ with no diode.'

anomalies.impact: The DC input is connected to the raw cell node (NET0044) instead of BAT+, so it no longer feeds the rail directly (it now passes through the battery diode, adding a drop) and is paralleled with the uncontrolled 18650 with no isolation diode between adapter and cell. Because the battery negative is also tied straight to GND, the barrel jack's internal switch cannot disconnect the battery when a plug is inserted. This reproduces the documented 'DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY' fault (commit a1d9676) that the intended rev D (af0d263) was supposed to fix.

parsed.summary: The schematic's part types and values match the specification throughout, but the DC barrel jack is mis-wired: its center pin lands on the pre-diode battery net (NET0044) rather than on BAT+ (NET0007), and the battery negative / switch pins are tied directly to GND, defeating the intended diode-OR and the battery-disconnect-on-DC behavior described in the spec and matching the historical 'pins are wrong, shorts battery' bug.
